decision.reason: the current plan contains an Evidence-build dependency cycle and the committed AIP baseline has no pre-compile aggregate that atomically freezes the four user-visible production contract refs

authorityRefresh.hardBoundary: No Agent is runnable and no real CapabilityBinding exists
authorityRefresh.interpretation: binding readiness progress does not provide an Evidence build path or a four-ref production-context freeze

committedM1Facts.evidenceBundleSemantics: EvidenceBundle is created frozen from a previously frozen TaskBrief and caller-supplied exact Evidence item refs
committedM1Facts.impactPreviewSemantics: ImpactPreview atomically snapshots Brief, EvidenceBundle, EvalContract and ResponsibilityPlan plus Plan, StageTemplate and optional runtime authorities; freeze revalidates the whole dependency snapshot
committedM1Facts.productionStartSemantics: Start consumes an already compiled Plan, frozen ImpactPreview and approved ActionProposal and revalidates them before creating TaskRun
missing: a pre-compile ProductionContextRevision or equivalent composite freeze authority
an atomic command that binds the four core refs before Plan compilation
an explicit ProductionContext ref carried into Plan, ImpactPreview and Start decision
a non-circular Evidence Build dependency before W3-04

oldEdges: W3-04 depends only on W3-03 but requires an EvidenceBundle exact ref
W3-03 now creates an EvidenceBuildRequest and deliberately does not execute a Provider-backed build
W4-01 creates the EvidenceBundle Build Job but currently depends on W3-14
W3-14 depends on W3-04 and later W3 tasks
using ImpactPreview as the W3-04 freeze also requires Plan and StageTemplate outputs that are produced during the later compiler/start path
forbiddenWorkarounds: create a fake or empty EvidenceBundle
freeze four authorities independently and let the Web client claim atomic success
run Evidence Provider work inside prepare
compile a Plan before the user-visible freeze without recording the ordering change
use latest refs or an unfrozen ImpactPreview

remediatedTargetSequence: W3-03 prepare creates or revises draft Brief, EvidenceBuildRequest and ResponsibilityRecommendation with zero provider execution
W4-01A or an equivalent explicitly authorized early bridge executes the Evidence Build Job and produces a canonical EvidenceBundle before W3-04; it must not depend on W3-14
the user confirms or canonical policy creates and freezes EvalContract and ResponsibilityPlan through their owners
W3-04 atomically creates and freezes a ProductionContextRevision containing exactly TaskBrief, EvidenceBundle, EvalContract and ResponsibilityPlan refs plus preparation and profile provenance
W3-05 canonical compiler consumes the frozen ProductionContext ref and StageTemplate to create Plan
ImpactPreview and ActionProposal are created and frozen after Plan exists, and Start revalidates ProductionContext, Plan, Preview, Proposal and runtime dependencies

atomicityAndCas: all four refs are re-read under one server-side decision and tenant scope
the aggregate is append-only; individual source objects remain owned by their canonical stores
same key and same request hash replays the same frozen context and Receipt
same key with a different hash conflicts and no partial aggregate is published
a crash before aggregate commit leaves no visible frozen context; a crash after commit is recovered by Receipt replay

unknown, revoked, expired, drifted, cross-tenant, placeholder, dry-run or profile-mismatched input blocks freeze

no Plan compilation, ImpactPreview or external business mutation
no protected content, credential or Secret disclosure
